title: Recurring unresolved limitation 'cross-sectional-design' across 6 independent papers
explanation: 6 independent papers (2017–2026) report an own-work limitation normalized to 'cross-sectional-design'. Methodological diversity: 7 distinct methods (NOTE: diversity/time-span weighting extends beyond opportunity-criteria.md). Resolution is ASSUMED absent — no limitation-resolution relation exists in Phase 3, so 'unresolved' is unverified. consumer.headline: 6 separate teams ran into the same wall: cross sectional design
consumer.kind_short: A problem that several independent teams ran into
consumer.kind_long: Papers describe the limits of their own work. When separate teams — who did not build on each other — keep reporting the same limit, that is a sign of a real obstacle rather than one group's bad luck.
consumer.strength_meaning: Several independent papers point at this, and we could read their full text to check.
consumer.why: 6 separate research teams each reported hitting this in their own work. They did not build on each other, so this is unlikely to be one group's bad luck. Their papers span 1 year. We could read 6 of them in full, which is where teams describe what actually went wrong.

caveats.label: Only counted within these 110 papers
caveats.text: These teams all hit this problem within this library of 110 papers, not the whole field. Work outside it may already have solved it. Check before you invest.
